Hi there,
I have a question: 

I entered Israel on February 27th, as a regular tourist so my permit is till May 27th. Now, rumor has it that because of the war, those permits to stay have been extended by 3 months... in other words without any extra bureaucracy in theory I could stay till August 27th. Correct? Are tourists also supposed to get some sort of notification about the extension? Because I never did. 

BUT also... if I plan to come back in the winter months for another 3 months and I'm not allowed to exceed 6 months in a year (center of life etc) does it still count or it's an exceptional situation and they won't make a big deal about that restriction? What do you think? TIA

Ps. My partner and I are still in the early phase of relationship so in the meantime before we commit to more serious steps I split my life (half/ half) between Israel and Poland .
